resources.string: Turn on Till Recorder in Accessibility. You only do this once.
Till Recorder watches this register screen for the shop. Turn this on once. It stays on after that, and a notice stays on the tablet while it is watching.
Remind me to start recording after the tablet restarts
Nothing is waiting on this tablet.

On the watch website, press Pair a register and type that code here.

Then turn on Till Recorder under Accessibility. You only do that once. If Android says the setting is restricted, open App info, allow restricted settings, and try again. After that, watching stays on by itself, including after a restart. A notice stays on this tablet while it is watching.

From the website you can turn the front camera on or off.
A clip includes everything on the screen. Use a register that hides card numbers, and only give the token to people who should watch the day.
